description: Linea di Costa is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. Mapping and classification of the shoreline, according to the RER methodology, based on aerial photos. The classification used is that proposed by (Apat) ISPRA: natural, protected, protected lagoon, fictitious and fictitious lagoon. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Costa Line" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2009-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
